about.title: About the TeRaź 1st Anniversary Project
about.description: The TeRaź 1st Anniversary Project is an unofficial fan-led celebration created by fans of TeRaź. Through anniversary messages, highlight collections, and other fan projects, we hope to preserve the memories we've made together throughout their first year. This project is not affiliated with or officially endorsed by Meridian Project, and does not represent the views of Meridian Project or the members of TeRaź.
